method: Report structure, reference targets, cited source link reachability, product coverage and private-path/local-identity scan; manual claim review. Not a security test or external product certification.
scopeChange: Function and licensing matrix minimized in favor of security per coordinator direction.
securityClaims: No blanket superiority or equality claim.
No inference-resistance claim from AES or per-row salts.
Snapshot-only, query-observation and trusted-key-service boundaries kept separate.
Vendor opacity is unknown, not evidence of weakness.
limitations: No physical WAL or page capture.
Piiano SDK 1.1.11 is not proof of current server internals.
Ciphertext authentication is not result-set completeness.
